issues.description: Method naming mismatch for the operation that feeds all animals: the template's commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java invokes farm.feed() (line 20), while the problem statement and the reference implementation define and describe the method as feedAllAnimals() (problem_statement.md lines 108-111 and solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java signature at line 27). This inconsistency will cause the provided example Main to not compile against the expected API and will confuse students which method name to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the starter code and specification consistent. Either (A) update the template Main.java example to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), or (B) add a convenience wrapper method public void feed() in the Farm class that delegates to feedAllAnimals(), and document this in the template. Prefer option A to match the problem statement and reference solution.
